description: Head and torso hold position; only the mouth shape and eye pupils change tile to tile (mouth open ellipse at f21/f22/f23, flatter at f24); detector peak value is small (1.65).
Banners, columns and carpet edges shift position between tiles and the throne grows slightly, consistent with a slow push-in or reframing; the seated character does not visibly move.
Seated character tilted while the hand with extended finger sits at right; little change among these three tiles.
At f327 the throne and hand appear larger and shifted versus f326 (columns and window larger), a sudden reframing rather than a gradual one.
Character is flicked off the throne: tilted off the seat at f328, rotated and moving left at f329, nearly gone at the left edge at f330; the hand stays at right with the finger extended.
Character has left frame by f331 leaving an empty throne and the hand held in place.
The peasant lies sideways near the path and the cottage and castle remain; only very small shifts (a slight scale change of the cottage) are visible across tiles.
Empty room with window and posts; no bed yet.
Sack bed enters from the top edge at f530, moves down and left through f531-f532, then back right to settle on the floor by f534-f535 (path read from tile positions).
Barrel with a bowl and the shelf unit drop in from the top at f555, move down and settle to the right of the bed and ring by f562; the bed and stone ring are already in place at f555.
Goat on white moves left across the frame; it is mostly cropped by f789.
Goat exits left; only a sliver remains at f790.
Hand-lettered word 'maybe' is already fully formed at f790 with no visible partial letters in the sampled tiles.
Room with the peasant and animals and no label at f854; a tiny scribble-like mark appears at f855 where the label will go.
White 'dirt' word and arrow appear: tiny mark at f855, then full word and arrow at f856, so the reveal takes about 2 tile frames.
Tiles are near-identical; the scene may darken or add haze slightly across the strip but no object motion is discernible at 480x270.
